title: Your second factor
intro: Open your authenticator app and type the code it shows for saras.
codeHint: Six digits. Without your app, type one of your recovery codes.
enrolWhy: This installation asks for a second factor: besides your password, a code from an app on your phone.
enrolIntro: In an authenticator app (Aegis, Google Authenticator, 1Password…), scan this code. Then type the six digits the app shows.
qrLabel: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
key: Or type this key in the app
recoveryIntro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes gets you in once, in place of the app’s code. Keep them somewhere safe: they are not shown again.
